name: Gaborone (Botswana)
description: A light-blue field charged at the centre with the arms of the Gaborone City Council: a gold shield with black devices, surmounted by a mural crown.
history: The city council's flag, in the light blue of the national flag with the council arms, flies at the Civic Centre; it was first reported in 2001. No adoption date has been published.

features.symbolism: the blue of the national flag

features.role: arms of the Gaborone City Council
